name: Gl1_LevelSet
description:
Renders LevelSet object

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_LevelSet.recompute(=false)

	Whether to recompute the triangulation every time it is rendered.

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_LevelSet.wire(=false)

	Only show wireframe.

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_LevelSet.surfNodes(=false)

	Render surface nodes<LevelSet.surfNodes>.

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_LevelSet.surface(=true)

	Render particle surface as a zero contour of the distance field<LevelSet.distField> using the Marching Cubes algorithm.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be a valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.
